evidence.rate_limit_mechanism: Monthly credit quota; exhausted credits block all inference

impact.description: 20x disparity in monthly inference credits between Free ($0.10) and PRO/Team ($2.00) tiers. Free tier users hit rate limits ~20x faster than paid users. No transparent per-request rate limit headers (x-ratelimit-*) documented for serverless inference; limits enforced via credit exhaustion which is opaque and unpredictable.

remediation.notes: No published rate limit headers for serverless inference; credits are the only limiting mechanism
